name: Cliamp
author: robbie
description: Bar widget for the cliamp terminal music player. The button sits in the bar's left section and lights up while cliamp is running; a dropdown controls playback and switches between the default stations and your favourites

barWidget.description: Music control for cliamp. The button stays on the bar and lights up while cliamp is running; it opens a dropdown with prev/play-pause/next plus a station picker (default stations or favourites).
